Streaming chat completion via the AWS Bedrock provider using the bedrock/ prefix — verifies SSE chunks are yielded and assembled correctly from the Converse streaming API

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"max_tokens\":32,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Count to three, one word per response.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"bedrock/anthropic.claude-3-sonnet-20240229-v1:0\",\"stream\":true}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.chatStream(req: _req)
var chunks: [LiterLlm.ChatCompletionChunk] = []
        for try await _chunk in result { chunks.append(_chunk) }
print(result)
```
